entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I think I need to return something? I'm not sure if I can. It's these cycling shoes I bought a few weeks ago. The website was a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I... I don't know, really. They just feel wrong. I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. And I can't figure out the cleats at all, they're so confusing. I just don't think they're for me. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear the fit isn't right and they're causing blisters. Comfort is the most important thing. Let me just pull up your order information. I see you received the cycling shoes 26 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. Is that too long?

Not at all. I'm checking our policy right now, and for standard items like these shoes, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. So yes, we can absolutely process that full refund for you.
Oh, really? Wow. That's a huge relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you so much.

Of course. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. Since this was a frustrating experience, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for a future purchase. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off. The refund will be processed as soon as we receive them.
Wow, a credit too? Thank you, Charlie! You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your business. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
My pleasure. Have a great day, and we hope you'll give us another try soon. Goodbye.
